p.i: QVOD Diogenes olim, viri Proceres, ciuibus suis sub publi-co periculo varie occupatis, dolium versando, ne otiosus esset, fecit, id mihi hoc afflicto Rei-pub. tempore, patriaq; laborante, vobisq; de publica salute consultantibus, faciendum putaui, idq; non fallendi otii causa, sed ut ciuis in-digena patriæ meæ, quantum per tenuitatem possem, talentulo hocce meo subuenirem. Illud quantulumcunq; sit, obnixè rogo, ut pro vestra benignitate boni consulatis: &, si lubet, animis vestris perpendatis: ac malis Reipub. patriaq; iustis remediis subueniatis. Medicorum autem more si quis per prognostica, indicia, & varias circumstantias morbos Reipub. consideret penitius, agnoscet facilè eorundem genuinam sub-stantiam, immensam magnitudinem, & admi-randam planè varietatem. Deinde si morborū publicorum caussa interius & foris diligentius perpendantur, primam certè, & omnium maximè principalem, Iesuitarum exquisitissimas

page.notes: The woodcut initial is read as Q, from the shape of the letter. The page number is printed at the top centre. The catchword "artes" is at the lower right. No running head is printed. Spelling and punctuation are as printed, including "patriaq;" and the doubled stop after "subueniatis".
